rules.title: Parking in North
rules.explanation: North-West and northern sectors are traditionally considered practical for vehicle movement.
rules.practical_impact: Provides traceable Knowledge coverage for parking placement.
rules.architectural_note: Follow local access, fire and parking regulations before altering the bay.
rules.existing_home_note: Keep access unobstructed and avoid long-term clutter around the vehicle.
rules.source_note: Belief-based guidance; interpretations and schools may vary.
